text.tspan: R54: the GF façade moves from y 25.10 to 24.10 — under the existing L2 slab, so no new structure; every room gains 1.00 m of depth (5.90 m). Row-4 columns
(y 25.10) now stand 1.0 m inside the rooms.
Back-of-court walkway 2.15 m from the rear-row court edge (y 21.95) to the façade; the new L2 slab edge (y 23.10) overhangs it at about +3.20.
Wet rooms unchanged and still behind grid 5 (drain rule); staff WC is existing (its 1.0 m forecourt y 24.10…25.10 stays open). S1 stair as R38; catwalk
RENTABLE GF: L1 14.8 + L2 14.8 + gift shop 16.5 + kiosk 6.1 = 52.2 m² (R44: 42.4 m²). Clinic 29.5 m² (was 24.5).
